name: Fairy Tale: Little Red Riding Hood and the Cursed Forest
source:
[This is the story of a failed fairy tale writer who died, got isekaid to a distorted fairy tale world, and was given a second chance in life.]

---

There was a world of hopes and dreams.

It was the world of fairy tales.

The world of good and evil, where good prevails and everyone lives happily ever after.

But that utopia is no more.

Because evil had grown to the point of corrupting the residents and stained the world with malice.

The main characters opened their eyes to their own greed and desires, deviated from the set ending, and developed the story in various directions.

Now, that utopia was nothing more than a remnant of the past.

And I, Lawrence, was a writer who died in the real world and was transported to this broken world. 

I have lost count of the number of times I almost died trying to survive in this dangerous world.

This is a recollection of the struggles I went through. 

And it all began here, the first fairy tale I encountered: 

"Little Red Riding Hood and the Cursed Forest."

[from [url=https://rizvn.itch.io/fairy-tale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
【这是一个失败的童话作家的故事，他去世了，进入了一个扭曲的童话世界，并获得了第二次生命的机会。】

---

那是一个充满希望和梦想的世界。

那是童话世界。

善恶世界，善良盛行，大家都过着幸福快乐的生活。

但那个乌托邦已经不复存在了。

因为邪恶已经发展到了腐蚀居民、用恶意玷污世界的地步。

主角们看清了自己的贪婪和欲望，偏离了既定的结局，使故事向各个方向发展。

现在，那个乌托邦只不过是过去的残余。

而我，劳伦斯，是一位在现实世界中死去并被传送到这个破碎世界的作家。

我已经记不清有多少次我为了在这个危险的世界中生存而差点丧命。

这是我所经历的斗争的回忆。

这一切都从这里开始，我遇到的第一个童话故事：

《小红帽与被诅咒的森林》。
